reason: Worked counterexample with explicit computation: the equally spaced triple on S1_l, l<2pi, has side midpoint at distance l/2 from the opposite vertex while the spherical comparison point is at arccos(cos(l/3)/cos(l/6))<l/2 by the addition formula and cos(2l/3)-cos(l/3)=-2 sin(l/2) sin(l/6)<0; hence CAT(1) fails, and a geodesic subspace of a CAT(1) space is CAT(1), so any space containing such a circle fails. Dependencies read. Level 10.
